prompt_md: Which odd number becomes even when you take away one of its letters?
prompt_short: Which odd number becomes even when you take away one of its letters?
hint_md: Look for a hidden word, not a hidden sum.
explain_intuition_md: Eleven looks promising because "even" is hiding inside it, but you would have to drop two letters. Drop the S from "seven" and you are left with "even".
